note: Representative subset for the coverage tracker — not the full ASVS catalog.

controls.title: Password length
controls.requirement: Verify that user set passwords are at least 12 characters in length.
preconditions: an authentication flow accepts user-chosen passwords
expected_evidence: registration/password-change accepts a 64-char password and rejects < 12
controls.limits: does not assess password storage/hashing (see V2.4)

controls.title: Session token generation
controls.requirement: Verify the application generates a new session token on authentication.
preconditions: a login flow issues a session cookie
expected_evidence: session id observed before vs after login differs

controls.title: SQL injection defense
controls.requirement: Verify that data selection or database queries use parameterized queries.
preconditions: the app issues database queries from user input
expected_evidence: injection payloads do not alter query semantics; SAST shows parameterization

controls.title: Security headers — content type
controls.requirement: Verify that every HTTP response sets a safe Content-Type with charset.
expected_evidence: responses carry Content-Type and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
